keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Largie Ramazani (Burnley).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Burnley 1, Charlton Athletic 0. Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Josh Laurent.
First Half ends, Burnley 1, Charlton Athletic 0.
Second Half begins Burnley 1, Charlton Athletic 0.

Goal! Burnley 1, Charlton Athletic 1. Kayne Ramsay (Charlton Athletic) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Lloyd Jones with a headed pass following a corner.
Goal! Burnley 2, Charlton Athletic 1. Largie Ramazani (Burnley) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Igor Julio following a fast break.
Conor Coventry (Charlton Athletic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Igor Julio (Burnley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Harvey Knibbs replaces Dan McNamara.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Ivan Mesík replaces Amari'i Bell.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Charlie Kelman replaces Oliver Skipp.
